top_signals.title: Trump Says US to Cancel Iran Attack Subject to a Rapid Deal
top_signals.summary: US President Donald Trump said the US will hold off new strikes on Iran after it was asked to by the Islamic Republic and other Middle Eastern nations because “perimeters of a deal has been agreed to.”
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: ASML’s Extreme Ultraviolet Lithography and the Limits of Reverse Engineering in China
top_signals.summary:
In June, the U.S. Department of Commerce informed the Dutch company ASML that it suspects one of its extreme ultraviolet lithography machines has reached China, an accusation that ASML denied, and for which no supporting evidence has yet been made public. ASML is the sole global producer of the machines capable of making the most advanced microchips.
